flowchart LR

  %% --- Définition des Styles ---
  classDef external fill:turquoise, stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px,color:#333, padding:5px
  classDef container fill:#1168bd,stroke:#0b4884,stroke-width:2px,color:#fff
  classDef component fill:#f3f3f3,stroke:#333,stroke-width:1px,color:#333
  classDef logic fill:#fff4dd,stroke:#d4a017,stroke-width:1px,color:#333

  %% --- Acteurs Externes ---
  subgraph user [👤 Utilisateurs initiaux]
    node_user[...]
  end
  class user external

  subgraph smart [🏢 Smart : Régulateur privé]
    node_smart[Service dédié ???]
  end
  class smart external

  subgraph regul[🏢 Régulateurs externes]
    node_regul[...]
  end
  class regul external

  subgraph recipent [🏛️ Destinataires des déclarations]
    node_recipent[...]
  end
  class recipent external

  %% --- Système Principal ---
  subgraph C4 [Container : Système de Conformité]
    direction LR

    subgraph sg_conformite [Régulation de la Conformité]
      direction LR
      subgraph sg_reg_decl [Régulation déclarative]
        normes[Entrepôt des normes]
      end
      subgraph sg_reg_biz [Régulation business]
        normes_biz[Idem...]
      end
    end
    class sg_conformite container

    subgraph sg_rules [Moteur de Règles]
      direction TB
      biz_rules[businessRules]
      legal_rules[legalRules]
      calc_rules[calculus]
    end
    class sg_rules logic

    subgraph sg_core [Cœur Métier]
      direction TB
      
      subgraph sg_scene [Scène d'affaires]
        subgraph sg_plan_rea [ ]
          direction LR
          events[Évènements]
          ssec[sketchonomics secondaires]
          sadd[sketchonomics additionnels]
        end
        
        subgraph sg_saisie [Saisie documentaire : sketchonomic initial]
          agentA[Agent A]
          agentB[Agent B]
          resX[Resource X]
          resY[Resource Y]
          
          agentA -- owns --> resX
          agentA -- wants --> resY
          agentB -- owns --> resY
          agentB -- wants --> resX
        end
      end

      subgraph sg_proj [Projections]
        p_compta[Projection comptable]
        p_decl[Projection déclarative]
      end
    end
  end

  %% --- Liaisons ---
  regul <-- parfois les mêmes --> recipent
  user ---> sg_saisie
  p_decl ---> recipent
  sg_scene ---> sg_proj
  sg_conformite ---> sg_rules
  sg_reg_decl ---> sg_proj
  sg_reg_biz ---> sg_scene
  smart ---> sg_conformite
  regul ---> sg_conformite
  sg_rules ---> sg_core
  sg_saisie ---> sg_plan_rea 
  


  %% Application des classes aux composants internes
  class normes,normes_biz,biz_rules,legal_rules,calc_rules,events,tva,cmf,p_compta,p_decl component
